assumptions: Native nominal values; no unstated tolerance or temperature corners imposed.
The 3.3 V case is conditional on a Polygonus GPIO powered at 3.3 V; the exact mated module is not in the candidate.
GPIO high-Z case excludes current into U11/U12 and A1; it is the unloaded Thevenin voltage, not a prediction of switch state.
Series resistor cannot raise the downstream input above an ideal voltage-driven source when that input consumes current.
65 uA at 5 V is a published supply-current maximum, not a valid model at 3.3 V; no current extrapolation is used.

LS9_LS10_GPIO_highZ.interpretation: Does not prove a failed stepper high. Does leave LS9/10 at a nonzero level with GPIO high-Z; VNL behavior unqualified here.

lowside_GPIO_3V3_case.interpretation: For either named VNL5090N3-E or SKU-selected VNL5050N3-E, N3 input is also its control supply. 3.3 V is below the published 3.5 V minimum. It is not evidence that every sample remains off.

CAN2_carrier.interpretation: Semiconductor input resistance is not a 120-ohm termination. Host module and harness termination are unknown. No frequency-domain or transmission-line conclusion is made.
